task.title: Recover Chrome from stale Pi frontend assets
task.classification: browser upgrade compatibility and Pi static asset delivery

coreClaim: Chrome recovers from stale Vite chunks after a Pi deployment, and the Pi web server no longer returns index.html with HTTP 200 for missing hashed assets.
rootCause: The Pi Nginx SPA fallback treated missing /assets files as navigation requests and returned index.html, while the current De-Koi client had lost its guarded stale-chunk recovery and its manual Refresh App action only performed an ordinary reload.

inScope: Shared browser runtime cache cleanup and cache-busted reload
Guarded vite:preloadError recovery before React startup
Existing Settings and crash-screen reload actions
Pi Nginx document and hashed-asset cache policy
outOfScope: Changing chats, settings, IndexedDB, server storage, or user data
Changing runtime APIs, generation, providers, or Rust storage

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Existing Chrome tabs and profiles recover from deleted Vite chunks without clearing persisted De-Koi content, while fresh navigations revalidate the HTML shell.
claimBoundary.riskType: upgrade compatibility cross-entrypoint browser startup and Pi web delivery
entrypoints: Pi Nginx /assets/ and SPA navigation routes
currentPathsOrFormats: Vite content-hashed JavaScript and CSS under /assets/
index.html SPA document with current chunk names
Cache Storage and Service Worker registrations when browser APIs are available
legacyPathsOrFormats: An already-open page referencing deleted hashed chunks from the preceding Pi image
A normal Chrome profile with a heuristically cached older index.html
A legacy service-worker registration or Cache Storage entry from an earlier build
outOfScopeClaims: This PR does not add offline support or register a new service worker.
This PR does not clear localStorage, IndexedDB, chats, settings, or server data.
This PR does not claim the fix is live until the exact merge-SHA web image is deployed and probed on the Pi.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Browser navigations and module requests shared one SPA fallback, so a missing JavaScript module received a successful HTML response and failed before React could render recovery UI.
contractLaneGate.producer: Pi Nginx static-file delivery plus Vite content-hashed build output
contractLaneGate.consumer: Chrome module loader and De-Koi app startup/reload controls
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Navigation requests may fall back to index.html, but missing assets must fail as assets and stale clients must get one guarded cache-clearing recovery attempt.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: docker/nginx/pi-web.conf returns 404 for missing /assets files and revalidates HTML; src/shared/lib/browser-runtime.ts clears disposable runtime caches and handles vite:preloadError once per 20-second cooldown.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src/features and the app shell own browser recovery actions, while the Pi Docker Nginx configuration owns static asset and SPA document delivery.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not hide the failure with a React-only blank-screen guard; the module load can fail before React starts, and Nginx must not return HTML for asset paths.
regressionProof: Temporary Pi Nginx config contract assertion

positiveRows.claim: The first Vite preload failure is handled by a cache-busted runtime refresh.
positiveRows.evidence: browser-runtime.spec.ts dispatches a cancelable vite:preloadError event and proves forceRefreshSpa receives chunk_reload.

positiveRows.claim: Manual and crash-screen reloads use the shared stale-cache recovery owner.
positiveRows.evidence: GlobalErrorBoundary.spec.ts proves Reload De-Koi calls forceRefreshSpa; SettingsSurfaces.tsx awaits the same function.

positiveRows.claim: Missing Pi assets stop falling through to SPA HTML.
positiveRows.evidence: The Nginx config contract assertion failed before the change and passed after /assets/ gained try_files $uri =404.

positiveRows.claim: The repository remains buildable and passes its full local gate.
positiveRows.evidence: pnpm build, pnpm check, and the full Vitest suite exited 0; Vitest reported 2666 passed and 1 skipped.

contradictionRows.claim: A genuinely broken build must not enter an infinite automatic reload loop.
contradictionRows.evidence: browser-runtime.spec.ts proves a second preload error within 20 seconds is not prevented and does not trigger another refresh.

contradictionRows.claim: Recovery must not erase persisted De-Koi content.
contradictionRows.evidence: browser-runtime.spec.ts preserves an existing localStorage value while unregistering service workers and deleting Cache Storage entries; production code never references IndexedDB or storage deletion APIs.

contradictionRows.claim: Unsupported or blocked runtime-cache APIs must not block navigation recovery.
contradictionRows.evidence: browser-runtime.spec.ts proves missing and rejected Service Worker/Cache Storage reads resolve without an error.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: A normal Chrome profile holding stale runtime state receives the recovery path.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Recovery is registered at app startup and clears legacy service-worker/cache state when those APIs are available before replacing the current URL.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Fresh/incognito navigation keeps ordinary SPA routing.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The Nginx location / route retains try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html while index.html receives no-cache, must-revalidate.
Browser runtime APIs are feature-detected, pnpm build and pnpm check passed, and no Tauri/Rust command boundary changed.

untestedRows: A post-fix phone browser session cannot be run until the exact merged web image is published and deployed to the Pi.
Docker Desktop was stopped locally, so the changed Nginx config was not exercised in a local container; exact image HTTP behavior is a required deployment proof.

ownedFacts.description: The currently deployed Pi returns HTTP 200 and Content-Type text/html for a nonexistent /assets/de-koi-stale-proof.js request.
The previous Refresh App handler only called window.location.reload even though its help text claimed cache and service-worker cleanup.
The shared recovery behavior is covered by focused public-function tests.
ownedFacts.evidence: src/shared/lib/browser-runtime.spec.ts passed 4 tests in the final focused run.

userActionCopy.description: No migration or destructive user action is required. Before deployment, an affected Chrome user can temporarily use incognito or clear only the pi:7860 site cache; De-Koi chats and server data remain on the Pi.
userActionCopy.source: Chrome site runtime cache for http://pi:7860
detectedLayouts: normal Chrome profile with stale HTTP/runtime cache

manualBlockers.item: Exact merge-SHA Pi web image deployment and phone-profile confirmation
manualBlockers.reason: The owner behavior and pre-fix live mechanism are proven locally. Exact post-fix HTTP and phone behavior are required before declaring the Pi deployment complete, not before PR review.

verification.baselineEvidence: pnpm check exited 0; the full Vitest suite separately reported 2666 passed and 1 skipped; pnpm build exited 0.

notes: The PR must not merge until hosted CI and current-head Bunny are green.
Deployment completion requires exact merge-SHA labels on both Pi containers plus root, health, and mount proof.
